reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount that every consumer already calls and takes the tolerance from the existing getApproxNumberThreshold instead of recomputing 7.5%.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; each call site only passes its own op field.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts in the helper that defines the expected schedule amount; forecast reads the op the same way it already reads the amount (`schedule._amountOp ?? conditions.amount?.op`).

scope.why: Helper change, op threaded to every caller, tests and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A single definition with a required op parameter makes every caller state which kind of amount it holds; inserting op before inverse changes the positional signature, and the editor reducer passes an explicit null, which is slightly opaque.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every consumer (preview, posting, updateActions, forecast, budget template, API, UI lists and balance) calls getScheduledAmount with its op.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, now taking op, which all code paths that plan a schedule amount call.
